_comment: Consolidated headline metrics. Every value here is reproducible from a committed benchmark artifact and pinned by a test. Do not hand-edit; regenerate from the benchmarks.
eval_method: grouped template split (seed=42) for headline; dedicated OOD natural-language paraphrase benchmark for generalization
note: OOD F1=0.7188 is the current same-detector regression result; the ~25-point drop from the 0.9714 grouped-split score quantifies how much of the headline is memorized surface structure. External InjectionBench/JailbreakBench-style fixtures (~0.98) retain canonical attack markers and are NOT a true OOD test.
